style: Theatrical cabaret ensemble funk and microtonal chamber folk. Harmony uses a pélog-informed non-equidistant pitch collection with microtonal interval friction and a strict dissonance tax budget. Melody features angular talking-drum speech-contours, zampoña panpipe hockets, and sweeping violin glissandi. Rhythm relies on cellular-automaton binary onset grids competing with dual entrainment clocks and motion-driven tempo accelerando. Timbre combines dry pizzicato upright bass, bowed cello, grainy viola, screeching violin, agogô bells, and talking drum. Performance attitude is sanctimonious carnival barker urgency with caffeine-fueled hyperactivity. Production features pirate radio transmission artifacts, groovebox pattern sequencing, and deliberate thermal throttling.
lyrics:
[SCENE START: PIRATE RADIO TRANSMISSION FREQUENCY DRIFT OVER SECTOR FOUR METROPOLITAN GRID]
[TEMPO: ACCELERATING VIA MOTION-DRIVEN ACCELERANDO WITH VOLUMETRIC EXTRUSION]
[LEADER AUDIO: SANCTIMONIOUS CARNIVAL BARKER, CAFFEINE CATASTROPHE VELOCITY, HIGH VOLTAGE JITTER]
Step right up, you sinners down in Sector Four, where the bureaucratic floor meets the closing door!
[DISTORTED ECHO GROUP: Step right up, down in Sector Four, rattling the rusted iron core!]
The filing cabinet of woe is open once again, churning out the paper trails of mortal men!
Pay your dissonance tax before the circuit blows and the entire underground network overflows!
[VIOLIN SCRATCH TONE: HIGH REGISTER ELEVATION CAROUSEL SCREECHING THROUGH THE DUST]
[UPRIGHT BASS PLUCK: SECTOR A FREQUENCY SWEEP RETAINING STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY]
[AGOGÔ BELL ANCHOR: UNEQUAL TIMELINE CLAVE STRIKING PRECISE METRIC PULSES]

[VERSE 1]
By decree of the infernal administrative board, every single tear is itemized, weighed, and stored!
Do not look at the glowing ceiling panels, do not check the malfunctioning digital clocks,
We are frantically balancing the ledger with a heavy, lead-lined, compartmentalized box!
[DISTORTED ECHO GROUP: Heavy box, heavy box, perpetual storage lock under the bedrock!]
[CELLULAR AUTOMATON RHYTHM: GENERATION 7 ONSET TRIGGERING UNFORESEEN CELLULAR MUTATIONS]
[ZAMPOÑA PANPIPE HOCKET: INTERLOCKED BREATHING PATTERNS SUSTAINING PNEUMATIC PRESSURE]
[MEMORY CONFIDENCE DROPS: VOLUME WANES AS THE INTERNAL BUFFER CONTINUES TO DRAIN]
Did you hear the ominous rumor traveling down the long and winding hearsay chain?
Someone accidentally spilled a massive bucket of dark and viscous arterial rain!
[TALKING DRUM PITCH BEND: IMITATING SPEECH CONTOURS ACROSS MULTIPLE PITCH CLASSES]

[CHORUS]
Step right up and witness the recursive rainbow funk vibrating through the junction bunk!
Mandelbrot merriment echoing endlessly inside the locked and rusted iron trunk!
Sierpinski’s sassy surprise is waiting ominously right upon the winding, dusty stair!
Apollonian gasket shenanigery spiraling outward into mathematical realms beyond repair!
[DISTORTED ECHO GROUP: Beyond repair! Beyond repair! Completely and utterly beyond repair!]
[VIOLA GRAINY SUSTAIN: INNER-VOICE FRICTION SCRAPING AGAINST THE SYNTACTIC BOUNDARY]
[DOUBLE BASS BOWED DRONE: TECTONIC LOW REGISTER VIBRATING THE CONCRETE SUB-BASE]
[OVERHEATING WARNING: SYSTEM TEMPERATURE RISING EXPONENTIALLY ACROSS ALL CORE PROCESSORS]

[VERSE 2]
[MOTION-DRIVEN ACCELERANDO KICKS IN FASTER WITH SEVERE FREQUENCY MODULATION]
[VOICE PITCH RISES WITH VERTICAL STANCE TRANSDUCTION AND GRAVITATIONAL SHIFT]
We calculated the exact probability matrix and found a catastrophic structural leak,
It has been dripping sideways along the primary conduits for a mortal week!
Friction is the primary currency, and unwavering compliance is the ultimate crime,
We are spending all the future just to awkwardly redeem the fleeting present time!
[DISTORTED ECHO GROUP: Redeem the time! Redeem the time! Before the bells begin to chime!]
[CELLO GUTTURAL BOW TEXTURE TEARING THROUGH THE UPPER HARMONIC OVERTONES]
[AGOGÔ BELL INTENSIFIES ITS TEMPORAL DRIFT AGAINST THE METRONOME GRID]
[COMPETING ENTRAINMENT CLOCK SHIFTS PULSE TOWARD AN IRRATIONAL RATIO]

[BRIDGE]
[DENSITY DECREASES MONOTONICALLY ACCORDING TO THE STRICT REGULATORY RULE]
Stripping out the heavy drums now, thinning out the vibrating string arrangements,
Listen carefully to the acoustic friction that uncompromised compliance brings.
Only three notes left in the microtonal pélog set, resonating in the wet dark,
Have you finally paid your metaphysical debt to the master of the iron mark?
[DISTORTED ECHO GROUP: Metaphysical debt! Metaphysical debt! No refunds left!]
[SOLO UPRIGHT BASS BOWED GLISSANDO SLIDING INTO THE SUB-AUDIBLE REGISTER]
[TRANSMISSION DROP: PIRATE SIGNAL CUTS ABRUPTLY TO CRACKLING WHITE STATIC]

[CHORUS]
Step right up and witness the recursive rainbow funk vibrating through the junction bunk!
Mandelbrot merriment echoing endlessly inside the locked and rusted iron trunk!
Sierpinski’s sassy surprise is waiting ominously right upon the winding, dusty stair!
Apollonian gasket shenanigery spiraling outward into mathematical realms beyond repair!
[DISTORTED ECHO GROUP: Beyond repair! Beyond repair!]

[OUTRO]
[THERMAL THROTTLING ENGAGED: TEMPO CRASHES DOWNWARD INTO SLUGGISH DECAY]
[SYSTEM OVERHEAT FAILURE: AUDIO BREAKDOWN INITIATING CASCADE PARITY ERRORS]
[FINAL AGOGÔ BELL RINGING ALONE IN THE DARKNESS OF THE ABANDONED SECTOR]
Step... right... up...
[TRANSMISSION ENDS WITH FINALITY]
caption: An avant-garde theatrical cabaret funk track governed by a carnival barker in hell. Built with pélog microtonal intervals, cellular-automaton rhythms, and physical transduction rules where vertical stance and memory confidence alter pitch and volume. Features a frantic motion-driven accelerando, pirate radio transmission artifacts, and thermal throttling failure modes under strict density and dissonance constraints.
